### bad choice of start/end (1)  {.smaller}


* sending 10 and 01 

   * 100000010000

* sending 1 and 001 

   * 100000010000
<hr class="vspace"/>
* oops!
* textbook example: start/end = 01111110  

   * (and escaping 11111 $\rightarrow$ 111110)
